the improvement of the three BSc perspectives is positively correlated with each other and that the learning and growth activities are more strongly related to financial performance than the internal processes and the customers.

(a) there is evidence that the three qualitative perspectives (learning and growth perspective, internal business and production perspective, customer perspective) are positively correlated with each other at a statistically and economically significant level; and (b) there is evidence of the existence of a positive relationship between the qualitative perspectives of BSC and financial performance.
